questions.stem: Which learning method does Data Clustering belong to?
questions.explanation: Data Clustering equals Unsupervised Learning, while Data Classification or Categorisation equals Supervised Learning.

questions.stem: Which learning method does Data Classification belong to?
questions.explanation: Data Classification or Categorisation is Supervised Learning: it works from labelled data with known outputs.

questions.stem: What kind of data does Data Classification use?
questions.explanation: Data Classification uses labelled data, whereas Data Clustering uses unlabelled data.

questions.stem: Which two algorithms are named as the common Data Clustering algorithms in data mining?
options: Gradient boosting and support vector machines
questions.explanation: The two common Data Clustering algorithms are K-means clustering and hierarchical clustering.

questions.stem: Which of the following is named as one of the most popular Data Classification algorithms in data mining?
questions.explanation: The most popular Data Classification algorithms are K-Nearest Neighbour and decision tree algorithms.

questions.stem: Grouping animals into those with two legs and those with four legs is an example of which technique?
questions.explanation: Clustering groups data by shared characteristics, such as animals with two legs and animals with four legs, whereas classification tags each item by its uniqueness.

questions.stem: Which statement about the output of Data Clustering is correct?
options: The output is unknown in advance
The output is known in advance
The output is always a single group
The output must match the training labels
The output is a decision tree
questions.explanation: Data Classification output is known, but Data Clustering output is unknown because no labels or training data are provided.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT true of Data Classification?
options: It is a form of Supervised Learning
questions.explanation: Training data is provided for Data Classification; it is Data Clustering that receives no training data.

questions.stem: At what stage are Data Classification and Data Clustering used in Machine Learning?
options: After the final model has been deployed
For pattern identification before complex algorithms come into action
questions.explanation: Both techniques are used for pattern identification before the more complex algorithms are applied.

questions.stem: On what basis is Data Classification performed?
options: The order in which data arrived
The uniqueness of the data, so that each item such as each animal is tagged separately
The storage cost of each record
questions.explanation: Classification is done based on the uniqueness of the data, tagging all animals separately, while clustering is based on characteristics.
